name: M. C. Conners
bio: M. C. Conners of Spearfish came to sell beef cattle to the company in 1884 and shipped a trainload to Chicago in 1885. In August 1886 he shipped forty-eight cars of cattle from Mingusville, and in September he passed through Medora following the first of five trains of his cattle shipped from there.

moments.label: Shipped 48 cars of cattle from Mingusville
